selection.name: SocratiCode
selection.role: C10: project-scoped code retrieval and MCP integration for Claude Code and Codex; coordinates persistent indexing and embedding services.
selection.install_command:
git clone https://github.com/giancarloerra/socraticode.git socraticode
cd socraticode
git checkout --detach 155ba9325f43a65c78a09930735b378f91651cf5
npm ci
npm run build
claude mcp add --scope user socraticode -- node "$PWD/dist/index.js"
codex mcp add socraticode -- node "$PWD/dist/index.js"
selection.install_source: Upstream source-install instructions and CI, adapted with an explicit commit pin. Requires Node.js 18.17+ and running Docker. This pin includes the September 30 transport fix that postdates release v1.16.0.

basis.shows: Scoped dense/BM25 retrieval, ignore rules, path/language filters, agent integrations, interchangeable embedding providers, persistent Docker volumes, and checkpointed indexing recovery.
Supported clone/build installation; README documents registering the built dist/index.js MCP entry.
Linux unit tests across Node versions, Windows Git-refresh tests, and integration testing with Qdrant and Ollama.
Successful CI at the selected September 30 default-branch commit.
Publisher-reported five-question VS Code comparison: 61.5% fewer context bytes and 31 versus five tool steps. It measures workflow efficiency, not retrieval accuracy.
September 28 release; repository is unarchived and its default branch committed September 30.

selection.name: Qdrant
selection.role: C01: persistent retrieval backend. SocratiCode provisions its documented v1.17.0 image and named volume automatically; latest standalone release is v1.19.1.
selection.install_source: Upstream README Docker quick start with an explicit release-pin substitution. The selected stack obtains persistent storage through SocratiCode's managed installation.

basis.shows: Payload filtering supports repository/path scoping; REST/gRPC interfaces and write-ahead logging provide a suitable persistent vector-search substrate.
September 4 release with Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 assets, including maintained data-consistency and unsafe-shutdown fixes.
Successful integration-test run; all five sampled recent workflows succeeded.
Unarchived repository; latest default-branch commit September 3. Push timestamps on other branches were not substituted for default-branch activity.

selection.name: ollama
selection.role: C03: compatible local embedding service; native installation also supports the selected indexer's documented macOS acceleration path.
selection.install_command:
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
ollama pull nomic-embed-text
selection.install_source: Ollama README's Linux installer; SocratiCode README documents nomic-embed-text predownload and native Ollama integration. Installer and model digest are unpinned.

basis.shows: Documented Linux and macOS install paths.
POST /api/embed supports individual and batched inputs, model selection, dimensions, and residency controls.
September 28 release with Linux amd64 and macOS distribution assets.
Unarchived repository with an October 2 UTC default-branch commit.
Five sampled PR test runs contained three successes and two failures; this sample does not establish release-wide test status.

not_selected.name: LanceDB
not_selected.reason: Maintained embedded retrieval database; completing this layer requires code-specific indexing, refresh logic, and agent integration beyond its documented database interface. [README](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/857e455361df77a0eb35e23764282e3d87dc1e44/README.md)

not_selected.name: semble
not_selected.reason: Strong CPU challenger with scoped cached indexes, incremental refresh, both agent integrations, and a public approximately 1,250-query evaluation. Its inspected documentation leaves external embedding-service compatibility and crash restore unverified. [README](https://github.com/minishlab/semble/blob/aa634b14dc81ba6925a130cb999081f3240e2a3c/README.md)

not_selected.name: pgvector
not_selected.reason: Maintained PostgreSQL vector extension; requires assembling the code indexer, embedding service, and agent-facing retrieval interface. [README](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector/blob/f37c13f68b57d2c3472b2214fbcff699d6d34876/README.md)

not_selected.name: vLLM
not_selected.reason: Maintained inference-serving component; a separate scoped code index and recovery workflow remain necessary. Reviewed evidence provides no target-host comparison supporting replacement of the selected embedding service. [README](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8486f1ebfe6e39a5513a8636e7f07ed9746f8be5/README.md)

not_selected.name: next-plaid
not_selected.reason: Strong challenger: publisher-reported ColGREP NDCG@10 is 0.859 for LateOn-Code and 0.846 for the default edge model, versus Semble's 0.853. ColBERT/ONNX integration differs from the selected stack; Codex integration is explicitly basic and interrupted restore remains unverified. [README](https://github.com/lightonai/next-plaid/blob/00e26aae0006b322727db277672211d9a0e3ccec/README.md)

not_selected.name: Haystack
not_selected.reason: Maintained RAG framework with broad provider flexibility; this requirement needs configuration of code-specific indexing, scoped storage, refresh, and agent integration. The selected application documents those together. [README](https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack/blob/9f31fb4b0ef318c51a6fa8ad30321336d99e2cb8/README.md)

not_selected.name: huggingface-hub-native
not_selected.reason: Maintained Hub SDK/CLI and useful model-distribution dependency; its documented purpose does not supply the complete local code-retrieval workflow. [README](https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface_hub/blob/1a76ad25c8f10fcd4ffa696d8289a3a1488dfa34/README.md)

excluded.name: nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 (embedding model)
excluded.fact: The packet identifies an embedding-model artifact and supplies no repository. The model alone is neither an embedding service nor a scoped, recoverable code index.

excluded.name: code-memory
excluded.fact: Latest default-branch commit and latest release are May 20, outside the 90-day window starting July 4, 2026. [Commit](https://github.com/kapillamba4/code-memory/commit/5a8db166ca11a90c093ba4a9a54d266cde756f54), [release](https://github.com/kapillamba4/code-memory/releases/tag/v1.0.33).

layers.deciding_comparison: The selection reflects the strongest documented complete-stack fit, without claiming measured retrieval superiority. Freeze one target-project commit, conceptual questions, and expected source spans. Compare SocratiCode/Qdrant/Ollama, Semble, and ColGREP with both documented models on WSL2/RTX 4090 and macOS arm64. Measure recall and NDCG, answer/source correctness with the same agent model, scope isolation, edit/delete/branch refresh correctness, cold/warm latency, indexing time, RAM/VRAM, interrupted-index recovery, and restored-state correctness and duration.
evidence_gaps: Judged as of October 2, 2026; the 90-day window starts July 4. All repository candidates except code-memory have verified default-branch commits within that window; none is archived.

No public common-arm evaluation separates SocratiCode from Semble and ColGREP. SocratiCode's public efficiency comparison and the packet's sealed 35-query comparison do not establish general retrieval superiority.

Persistence and indexing resume are documented. A complete backup/disaster-restore procedure and measured restore correctness were not verified; a stable index snapshot is not proof of backup restoration.

Linux installation paths and macOS distribution paths are documented. WSL2/RTX 4090 operation, GPU prerequisites, and macOS arm64 performance were not tested. SocratiCode's broad Windows Docker GPU statement was not generalized to WSL2.

Latest releases were checked for SocratiCode, Qdrant, Ollama, next-plaid, and code-memory. Other candidates' release histories and recent issue/PR activity were not sampled. Semble and next-plaid CI execution results were not sampled.

The recommended SocratiCode source pin includes an unreleased transport fix and matches successful upstream CI. Ollama binary/model digest pins remain unresolved. No installation or tests were executed locally.

Research used 30 GitHub API calls and two web searches. Five requested page fetches retrieved no pages. ctx_fetch_and_index was rejected with 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'; upstream documents were instead obtained through the allowed GitHub GraphQL API, indexed, and read using ctx_search. Only the packet was read under the local project directory.
